findings: The verifier now reaches the rows 2-4 local32 sibling: the trace shows gguf_iq4_xs_local32_gemv_kernel<2,2>, <2,3>, <2,4>, <4,2>, <4,3> in the verifier path, and the strict gguf_iq_dense_strict_kernel is left at rows 1.

Binding the dense-IQ execution owner in the block verifier was necessary: the verifier's raw-IQ rows 2-4 arrive under the prefill_bf16_bf16_out parent variant, and without the binding every raw-IQ projection kept the strict per-row GEMV.
All four arms still pass the complete section-6.1 screen with at least 24x margin on the binding mean limit and 100% top-1 overall and per category, with two bit-identical repeats.

The residual did not collapse. It is dominated by the t16 decode-versus-rowtile accumulation order (Q4_K 27.4% + Q5_K 25.7% + Q6_K 8.1% of rank-2 MACs), not by the IQ owner, so the IQ-owner mismatch was a smaller share of the Phase 3 residual than the Phase 3 note implied.
limitations: Four arms, budgets B1-B3, contexts 64 and 512. c2/c4/c8, contexts above 512, Q8 alpha/beta transitions, and sampling remain open (unchanged from Phase 3).

The rows 5-8 verifier is deliberately outside this binding: the verifier context is entered only for row counts a verifier policy declares, so the dense-IQ prefill policy (min_rows 8) cannot be reached through it.
Kernel-level rates for the sibling are in 2026-09-12-ud-gfx1100-phase4-local32-rows-headroom.json; the end-to-end effect is in the paired artifact.
